edl.title: Pikaboo Duels Payo, Payo Quits, Then Pikaboo Messages Him
edl.premise: Pikaboo accuses WoW rogue Payo of stream sniping and duels him. Payo quits after one fight, and Pikaboo then sends him a patronizing message.
edl.central_question: Will Payo's quit get the last word, or will Pikaboo?

beats.purpose: Pikaboo accuses Payo of stream sniping and says he will play by his own rules, which sets up the duel.
Duel ends, Payo quits after one fight: "GGs, that's it, one and done, I'm out."
Pikaboo messages Payo: "Good duels, brother", then says Payo has zero shot against a player of his caliber.

narration.text: Pikaboo says Payo stream‑sniped him; Payo, WoW rogue streamer
narration.essential_because: The footage never says who Payo is to Pikaboo.

sources.summary: Streamer Payo says he was banned by Blizzard for asking his viewers to buy him gold for a tournament, apologizes repeatedly, calls himself a hypocrite, and says he will never promote gold buying again

Pikabooirl reacts to Payoo, whom he accuses of stream sniping, and duels him in WoW. Payoo loses a short fight with Pika's pet and the stun, then says 'GGs, one and done, I'm out' and leaves. Pika lau
Payo plays an MMO with a full inventory open, a delete-item confirmation prompt appears around 11s, and at the end he says he just deleted 'the bomb' and reacts with disbelief.
Xaryu reacts to a World of Warcraft clip in which a player, apparently Payo, misclicks a confirmation prompt and deletes a new item, and he laughs about it repeatedly.
The streamer reads out a message to an opponent after a duel, first offering 'good duels' and then a condescending line saying they have no chance against players of his caliber.
